information_classes.deployable_forecast: A source cycle with a preserved issue time and a defensible first-available/publication time; only usable after both are no later than the decision cutoff.
information_classes.realized_evaluator_context: Retrospective reanalysis or post-event reconstruction; never an input to a deployable policy.
information_classes.in_situ_validation: Instrument observations with station, sensor, timestamp, quality flags and uncertainty; spatially sparse and not a continuous route-wide field.
information_classes.commercial_route_reference: A route result from a licensed commercial system; route geometry alone does not reproduce the forecast, polar, settings or computation.

source_records.dataset_name: NCEP GFS 0.25 Degree Global Forecast Grids Historical Archive
source_records.temporal_coverage: 2015-01-15 onward; exact object availability and retained periods must be checked per cycle
source_records.cadence: Forecast cycles at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC; 3-hourly leads through +240 h, then 12-hourly through +384 h
source_records.role: Primary candidate historical forecast archive for forecast-blind replay
source_records.admissibility: A cycle can enter a deployable decision snapshot only where issue time, object first-seen/publication time and data validity are independently recorded and the object was available by the decision cutoff. Do not substitute ERA5 or later analyses for missing forecast cycles. First-availability claims require an immutable evidence-artifact reference and digest, not only a typed evidence class.
known_limits: GFS model configuration evolves; preserve cycle and parameter metadata
The GDEX page states the archive copy is moving to an AWS mirror and RDA updates stop in early 2026
The catalogue's 0.25-degree forecast grid is not equivalent to higher-resolution coastal forecasts
Do not interpret archive ingest time as original operational availability without source evidence
source_records.rights_review: Record NOAA/UCAR attribution and dataset access terms from the current metadata before redistribution; do not re-host raw data without reviewing terms

source_records.dataset_name: Recent high-resolution GFS analysis and forecast
source_records.cadence: 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC cycles; forecast fields at 3-hourly steps through +384 h
source_records.role: Recent-cycle operational cross-check and current capture source
source_records.admissibility: Use only as-of captured forecast objects with first-seen timestamps; the trailing window is not a substitute for a long historical forecast archive. First-availability claims require an immutable evidence-artifact reference and digest, not only a typed evidence class.
known_limits: Only trailing 30 days at this high resolution according to NCEI
NCEI currently warns cloud migration may delay archival and update cycles
source_records.rights_review: Review current NOAA/NODD metadata and attribution terms

source_records.dataset_name: ERA5 hourly data on single levels
source_records.role: Retrospective atmosphere and surface-field evaluator context; not a forecast
source_records.admissibility: Evaluator-only. ERA5 is a reanalysis that assimilates observations and is not constrained to have been available at a historical decision time; it is not direct in-situ truth.
known_limits: Reanalysis uses later observations and retrospective processing
Spatial and temporal resolution differ from operational forecast products
Do not leak reanalysis values into deployable policy inputs

source_records.temporal_coverage: 1980-01-01 through 2026-08-31 in the current catalogue snapshot
source_records.role: Retrospective wave-state evaluator context and cross-check
source_records.admissibility: Evaluator-only reanalysis. Never treat it as the wave forecast that a historical routing policy saw.
known_limits: Retrospective reanalysis is not the forecast stream
Product versions can change; preserve product version and quality-document revision
source_records.rights_review: Copernicus Marine describes its data as free/open; retain product-specific license and required attribution

source_records.dataset_name: Station-specific historical buoy and C-MAN observations
source_records.cadence: Sensor/product-specific; retain native sampling and aggregation
source_records.role: Independent point-observation checks for wind, waves and meteorology
source_records.admissibility: Use only with station metadata, sensor/quality flags and spatial representativeness limits. A buoy observation is not a continuous field across an offshore route.
known_limits: Station record periods and observed variables differ
Historical archive documentation identifies station-specific annual/monthly files
source_records.rights_review: Retain NOAA source attribution and relevant data metadata

source_records.role: Licensed commercial route-output baseline where export and reproducibility conditions are met
source_records.admissibility: A route export alone is a route geometry reference, not a full reproducible benchmark arm. Mark the comparison incomplete when the exact forecast snapshot, vessel polar and settings are not available under license.
known_limits: Commercial rights and access are required
The provider's help says route accuracy depends on forecast and boat polars and that routes require skipper safety review
Do not infer missing forecast or polar inputs from the route geometry
PredictWind states its DataHub AI Polars are proprietary and cannot be downloaded/exported for use in other systems; do not infer them from GPX/KML/CSV route geometry.
source_records.rights_review: No redistribution or public hosting without applicable license/permission

frozen_replay_rules: Never substitute retrospective reanalysis for a missing historical forecast cycle.
Every decision snapshot requires source issue time, source first-available time, valid time, retrieval time, immutable object digest and exact parameter/grid metadata.
A deployable policy may consume a forecast only after it was demonstrably available and no later than the decision cutoff.
Reanalysis and post-event observations remain evaluator-only; evaluator truth must never be supplied back to a deployable policy.
Point buoy observations validate local cells/time windows but do not authorize global spatial interpolation.
No commercial route result is a reproducible baseline unless forecast, polar, route constraints, comfort/fallback settings and output are licensed and sufficiently captured.
No data is downloaded, redistributed or called rights-cleared by this register; this is an inventory and qualification plan.
next_deliverables: Rights and terms review for each chosen dataset/version
Frozen source manifest with immutable object digests and metadata
Station-to-grid observation cross-checks and uncertainty report
